cards.title: Paragraphs with
cards.body:
`

` holds a paragraph of text. Each paragraph starts on a new line, with space around it.

cards.title: Spaces get squashed
cards.body:
HTML turns extra spaces and line breaks into a single space. To start a new paragraph, use a new `

`.

check.question: How many paragraphs does this show?
